description: Rebuild the API Lambda to match section 5's 11 endpoints exactly, implement stage orchestration with partial retry (Task #8-9 from spec), and update CDK infrastructure to match the new architecture. Remove teaser-related constructs and add new stage workers.
steps: Rewrite lambdas/api/src/index.ts routes to match section 5 exactly: POST /projects, POST /projects/{id}/outline, PUT /projects/{id}/outline, POST /projects/{id}/deck, POST /projects/{id}/source-upload-url, POST /projects/{id}/source, PUT /projects/{id}/output, POST /projects/{id}/narration, PUT /projects/{id}/narration, POST /projects/{id}/renders, GET /projects/{id}/renders/{renderId}, GET /projects/{id}/renders/{renderId}/artifacts

Rewrite lambdas/api/src/handlers/ to implement each endpoint: projects.ts (create/list), outline.ts (generate via Bedrock, save confirmed), deck.ts (generate slides via Marp), source.ts (presigned URL + register), output.ts (save output settings), narration.ts (generate AI drafts, save confirmed + lexicon), renders.ts (start render pipeline, get status, get artifacts with presigned URLs)
Update lambdas/api/src/middleware/auth.ts to enforce Cognito auth and verify projectId ownership

Rewrite lambdas/slide-generator/ for outline generation using Bedrock Converse API. Record usage.inputTokens/outputTokens for cost. Generate slide outline based on user input (topic, source text, reference URLs, audience, pages, tone, theme, content language)

Rebuild infra/src/main-stack.ts: Remove teaser-related constructs (TeaserGeneratorConstruct, TeaserCompositionBuilderConstruct, TeaserStateMachineConstruct). Remove composition-builder-construct. Add new Lambda constructs for caption-worker, clip-worker, concat-worker. Rebuild RenderStateMachineConstruct as 5-stage pipeline with per-stage failure handling and re-run capability.

Update infra/lib/render-state-machine-construct.ts to implement the 5-stage pipeline: pages -> audio -> captions -> clips -> concat. Each stage updates manifest.stages. Failed stage can be retried without re-running prior stages.
Update infra/lib/api-construct.ts to define all 11 API routes with Cognito authorizer
Update infra/test/main-stack.test.ts to test new architecture: 11 API methods, 5-stage state machine, no teaser resources, new Lambda functions
Remove packages/renderer-hyperframes/, packages/evaluation/, packages/renderer-contract-tests/ (not needed in new arch)
Update pnpm-workspace.yaml if any workspace paths changed
Add cost tracking: tag all Lambda invocations and S3 writes with projectId/renderId/userId. Add cost calculation logic that records usage from API responses.
Create docs/cost.md documenting the cost allocation tag setup procedure
acceptance_criteria: API has exactly 11 endpoints matching section 5
All endpoints require Cognito authentication (return 401 without token)
ProjectId ownership is verified (return 403 for other user's project)
State machine implements 5-stage pipeline with independent re-run
Teaser-related code is removed from deployable paths
CDK synth succeeds (validated via test suite)
docs/cost.md exists with tag setup procedure
